ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: sum of the four quarterly DPS facts 2025-09-28..2026-07-05
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2010-04-04..2026-07-05; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2009-07-05..2009-10-04, 2 facts); the paid tag stopped: its newest fact (2024-09-29) is 644 days older than the declared tag's (2026-07-05) — declared is primary
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-09-28, 2025-12-28, 2026-04-05, 2026-07-05); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: the year most of each fiscal year falls in — two fiscal years end in the same calendar year; join on period_end, not the label
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-28..2026-07-05
dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-28..2026-07-05

dividend_yield.basis: sum of the four quarterly DPS facts 2025-09-28..2026-07-05

notes: dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2010-04-04..2026-07-05; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2009-07-05..2009-10-04, 2 facts) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)
annual_dps: FY2021 = sum of the four filed quarterly DPS facts (no FY fact)

annual_dps labels: FY2016 here (period ended 2017-01-01) is labelled FY2017 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2020 here (period ended 2021-01-03) is labelled FY2021 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2021 here (period ended 2022-01-02) is labelled FY2022 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2022 here (period ended 2023-01-01) is labelled FY2023 in the annual / quarterly tables — two fiscal years end in the same calendar year (a 53-week year or a fiscal-year-end change); join on period_end
